UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Career profile dossier, salary expectations, target roles, and app preferences for an authenticated KarirKu user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: User full display name shown on the dossier header.

headline.description: Professional role headline such as Senior Product & UX Designer.

location.description: City or region preference such as Jakarta Selatan.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Google account.

targetRoles.description: Bounded list (max 10) of target job role titles.

expectedSalaryMin.description: Minimum monthly gross salary expectation in IDR.

expectedSalaryMax.description: Maximum monthly gross salary expectation in IDR.

preferredWorkTypes.description: Bounded list (max 10) of preferred work arrangements and locations.

followUpRemindersEnabled.description: Whether follow-up reminder badges are enabled.

darkModeEnabled.description: Whether dark theme mode is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon modification.

JobApplication.title: JobApplication
JobApplication.description: Individual job application dossier entry tracking stage, compensation, work model, dates, notes, and attached file metadata.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the application owner.

dossierCode.description: Short dossier identifier code such as #ID-8849.

salaryMin.description: Minimum offered or expected gross monthly salary in IDR.

salaryMax.description: Maximum offered or expected gross monthly salary in IDR.

appliedDateMillis.description: Application submission date in epoch milliseconds.

targetResponseMillis.description: Expected response or follow-up date in epoch milliseconds.

notes.description: Role responsibilities, evaluation notes, and markdown bullets.

attachments.description: Bounded list (max 10) of attached document summary strings.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon modification.

InterviewSchedule.title: InterviewSchedule
InterviewSchedule.description: Scheduled interview, assessment, or follow-up session in the user's career calendar.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the schedule owner.

applicationId.description: Optional linked JobApplication document ID or empty string.

companyName.description: Company name for this interview session.

roleTitle.description: Role title associated with this interview.

stageTitle.description: Stage title such as Interview HR & User or Technical Test.

scheduledAtMillis.description: Scheduled session timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

meetingLocation.description: Meeting URL, platform name, or office address.

interviewerName.description: Name or role of the interviewer.

completed.description: Whether the interview session has been completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon modification.

CareerDocument.title: CareerDocument
CareerDocument.description: Resume, portfolio link, or certification entry saved in the user's career dossier.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the document owner.

title.description: Document display title such as CV ATS-Friendly 2026.

subtitle.description: Descriptor metadata such as PDF • 2.4 MB or Behance • 8 Proyek.

externalUrl.description: External link or file reference label.

verified.description: Whether this credential or document is marked verified.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon modification.

/users/{userId}.description: User-owned career dossier profile and preferences.
